conventions: Where two לְ + infinitive construct phrases stand asyndetically and the ASV coordinates them with and (plain in v2, italic in v3), the and is its own added unit under rule 14's closing sentences; the second לְ takes only what the ASV writes for it (to in v3, nothing in v2, rules 52/40) and is not read as the connective's home on the pattern of rule 26's בֵּין X לְ Y, which governs only that construction.

עַד heading the verbless predicate of extent (אֱמוּנָתְךָ עַד־שְׁחָקִים) takes the italic reacheth together with unto as the construction-supplied linking verb (rules 20, 49), on the footing of לְ → endureth for ever: a bare is in its place says what the Hebrew says, so reacheth is a copula of extent and not a supplied lexical verb. Marking it added was the alternative considered.
report: Read all 13 verses end to end against the contract; every source and target id is partitioned once and no cross-verse split was found.

Candidate table: every multi-treatment lemma is licensed by the ASV. Sp3ms → himself / his own / his (v2) are three different English realizations; לְ R→Vqc That vs unrepresented (v2) is one complementizer written and one purpose לְ left with no word (rules 52, 40); לְ Rd→Td For (v0) vs of (v1) are the superscription formula and a possessive; רָשָׁע 'of the wicked' (v11, anarthrous rectum, rule 46) vs 'wicked' (v1, article present taking the) differ because an article morpheme stands in v1.

Recurring constructions are consistent: prepositional predicates take the construction copula on the preposition (v5 is in, v6 is like, v9 with is, v5 reacheth unto); nominal/adjectival predicates take it themselves (v3, v6, v7); vocatives take O (v5, v6, v7); a coordinating and supplied between two asyndetic לְ + infinitive phrases is added in both v2 and v3 rather than given to the second לְ; paragogic nun unrepresented in v7 and v8; anarthrous substantival participles/adjectives take their supplied the / them that (v10, v11, v12).

BSB disagreements are all convention, none an error: v2 אֶל has no word because its object is rendered as the reflexive himself (rule 40); v2 second לִ has no English (rules 40/52); v7 and v8 paragogic nun (rule 32).

Added units (v0 A Psalm, v2 not, v2 and, v3 and) each answer to no morpheme and their notes name the alternative; the interpretive not of v2 is corroborated as unlicensed by the ASV margin 'Until his iniquity be found'.

Head choices to be aware of, both noted in-verse with the competing reading and not changed here: v0 Chief Musician heads on Musician (a rule 31 tie; the head used in other finished Psalm superscriptions was not in the precedent shown), and v1 לְנֶגֶד → before heads on the opening לְ per rule 23's compound-preposition sentence since נֶגֶד is tagged R.
Nothing in this chapter generalises beyond rules already in the contract; no promotion or amendment.
